dataset_name: MoS2 Contact Resistance & Schottky Barrier Height Benchmark

device_id.description: Unique primary key identifier for each experimental contact device instance.

source_uid.description: Unique identifier linking the observation to its peer-reviewed literature source paper.

contact_metal.description: Elemental or compound chemical formula of the primary contact metal pad (e.g., Bi, Ti, Au, Pt, Ag, Sc, Ni).

layer_count.description: Number of MoS2 atomic layers in the transistor channel (1 = monolayer, >1 = few-layer).

contact_resistance_ohm_um.description: Width-normalized contact resistance extracted experimentally via TLM, Y-function, or 4-probe.

log10_contact_resistance_ohm_um.description: Base-10 logarithm of width-normalized contact resistance (ML regression target).

work_function_ev.description: Work function of the clean bulk contact metal in vacuum.

physics_predicted_sbh_ev.description: Calculated or experimentally determined Schottky barrier height at the metal-MoS2 junction.

gate_carrier_density_cm2.description: Electrostatic gate-induced 2D sheet carrier density accumulated in the MoS2 channel beneath the contact.

is_vdw_or_depinned_contact.description: Flag indicating whether contact was fabricated via damage-free van der Waals transfer / phase transformation (1) or evaporated (0).

sulfide_formation_enthalpy_ev.description: Standard Gibbs free formation enthalpy of the metal sulfide compound, proxying interfacial chemical reactivity.

metal_resistivity_ohm_cm.description: Bulk room-temperature electrical resistivity of the contact metal.

temperature_k.description: Measurement ambient temperature during electrical characterization.
